Which of the following best describes the fallacy of special pleading?
Option A: Reasoning that ideas presented in an appealing manner are correct, regardless of the content of the message.
Option B: Using language and punctuation in a way that a statement can have multiple interpretations, so it's not really clear what is meant.
Option C: Confusing figurative language with literal language.
Option D: Referring to an act committed by an opponent in negative terms while referring to the same act committed by the arguer or supporters in favorable terms
